title: Universality of Affine Hashes
statement: Let $F$ be a finite field. The family of maps $x\mapsto ax+b$ from $F$ to $F$, indexed by $(a,b)\in F\times F$, is universal: for every pair of distinct $x,y\in F$, at most a fraction $1/|F|$ of the pairs $(a,b)$ satisfy $ax+b=ay+b$.
